consequence.statement: Queries that previously extracted multiple values into the same label will now extract only the first value, potentially changing query results.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changes label parsing logic in metrics and logs queries to extract only the first label when multiple extractions into the same label are requested, instead of parsing all of them.

consequence.statement: Metrics and logs queries that request multiple extractions into the same label now both parse only the first label. They still run, but their extracted label values (and so their results) may differ from before the fix.
consequence.remediation: Check queries that extract into the same label more than once, and make sure the first-label-wins semantics give the intended results.

corrected.statement: In Loki 3.0.0, metrics and logs queries that request multiple extractions into the same label both parse only the first label. Results of such queries may differ from before the fix.

decision.reason: [ev-d6a898e57d04] is a bug-fix entry saying that metrics and logs queries now both parse only the first label when several extractions into the same label are requested. Nothing in it says anything fails or is rejected, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. The proposed statement goes further than the evidence by saying such queries "previously extracted multiple values". The entry gives only the new, aligned behavior, not what each query type did before, so the statement is narrowed to what the entry says.
